pages.text: $(#00BFFF)🌊 Tidal Pact · Mermaid’s Secret Brew 🐚$()$(br2)$(l)$(#1E90FF)「Drink this solidified wave, and let your blood resonate with the tides」$()$(br)The flexibility of $(#228B22)Deep Sea Kelp$(), the icy sharpness of $(#87CEEB)Everfrost Crystal$(), the spiral wisdom of $(#6A5ACD)Nautilus Shell$(), and the sweetness of $(#DAA520)Amber Honeydew$() merge within the $(#000080)Tidal Stone Mortar$()—an ancient oceanic elixir capable of $(l)granting terrestrial beings temporary oceanic abilities$().

$(#1E90FF)▌ Twin Blessings of the Sea God $()$(br2)$(l)$(#00CED1)🐬 Dolphin’s Blessing$()$(br)Leaves behind $(#87CEEB)bubble trails$() when swimming, increasing speed.$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)🧜 Mermaid’s Lungs$()$(br)Automatically generates $(#00BFFF)oxygen bubbles$() underwater.

$(br2)$(#228B22)▌ Intertidal Brewing Process $()$(br)- Soak $(#228B22)Seaweed$() in $(#00BFFF)tidal water$() until it turns $(#32CD32)emerald green$().$(br)- Use a $(#6A5ACD)Shell Mortar$() to grind $(#87CEEB)ice blocks$() into $(#B0E0E6)stardust-like powder$().$(br)- Stir the mixture counterclockwise while blending in $(#DAA520)honey$().$(br2)$(#7FFFD4)※$() When the liquid forms $(#00CED1)mini whirlpools$() and emits $(#E0FFFF)pearl-like glow$(), the brew is complete.

$(br2)$(#000080)『 Oceanic Stone Tablet 』$()$(br)An inscription salvaged from a shipwreck:$(br)'Those who drink this $(#1E90FF)Sea God’s Pact$(),$(br)shall receive the $(#00CED1)swiftness of Delphinus$() and the $(#4169E1)lungs of Amphitrite$()—$(br)But remember, when the $(#DAA520)honey glow$() fades,$(br)one must immediately return to $(#228B22)land$() or risk turning into $(#6A5ACD)coral$(), forever bound to the $(#000080)abyss$().'
